svg.title: Grouping allowances and nested-root recovery. Retain the actual local allowance W ′ γ, cover, occupancy, normalized stage density and dominated profiles from (OE9). Their configuration reader is the same local grouped function and its coefficient polynomial. Conditional-integration recovery preserves that positive normalized density before the remainder is read. Pruning is the scalar operation c Wγ = W ′ γ/8, so the source recovers exactly
